senses.en_definition: Forced or obliged to do something because there is no other choice.

collocations.en: have no choice but to move
be forced to bear the losses

messages.en: I've got to head home early today. My kid's at home with a fever, and my wife has to go in to work.
Have you told the boss? If you have, go ahead and head home. I'll take care of the remaining files.
Yeah, he said it was fine. Thanks, I'll send you my work notes later.
I've been stuck in this traffic for almost an hour now.
No worries, we'll just wait at the café. Drive safely, okay?

senses.en_definition: Able to be expressed or described in words; chiefly in older usage and negative expressions.

collocations.en: a name known far and wide (archaic)

messages.en: Have you read the training notice HR sent to the group chat earlier?
Yeah. That notice doesn't even give a deadline. Do you know when it is?
I'm not sure either. I'll check with HR and let you know.

collocations.en: be captivated by the beauty of nature

messages.en: I'm thinking of signing up for that photography class. Want to join me?
Yes! I've already checked the timetable. Classes are only on weekends.
